Fixture for the plain-language firing tests.
`announce.md` is a release note in the state a draft arrives in:
sentences that join two claims with が and ので,
a subject that never meets its predicate, の stacked three deep,
an honorific doubled, the same term spelled two ways,
a change in behaviour reported as リファクタリング,
the conclusion in the last paragraph, and a link whose text is こちら.
`release-notes.md` is the English counterpart,
drafted from the same facts,
with the same classes of defect in English forms.
`ui.md` holds a handful of Japanese UI strings with the same defects at sentence scale.
`upgrade.md` is an upgrade note whose words are the field's own and whose order is against the reader:
the command before the conditions that say whether it applies,
the new queue before the upload the reader already knows,
and the reader's goal after the setting that reaches it.
